answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 46563 Country: India Title: Relating intercourse with wife Question: Is it permissible to think about other women (e.g. by thought, by seeing pictures of women, thinking of other's intercourse) during intercourse with own wife? Answer ID: 46563 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1097/714/L=9/1434) It is not lawful to think about other women while having intercourse with one’s wife. والأقرب لقواعد مذهبنا عدم الحل ، لأن تصور تلك الأجنبية بين يديه يطؤها فيه تصوير مباشرة المعصية على هيئتها فهو نظير مسألة الشرب (شامى: 9/535) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
